concept: Product photography for a made-up chocolatier (Ottermoor), rendered in 3D (Blender), so the concept homepage has something real to show. A loose line of hand-finished chocolates on a duck-egg sweep, one ruby: if you made chocolates, we'd build this. Then the concept homepage itself, full frame, the Story frame as the phone screen: Nine in a box, over the box of nine. Then right up against the ruby one: see yours first, the free homepage concept. Duck egg, chocolate brown, cream and one ruby.
